$comment: Engine role-label vocabulary: every closed role key of vocab.json (the internal, engine-understood roles like _price/_rating) mapped to the human label every target prints for it. CONSUMED ONLY through m1/axis.mjs (roleLabel/columnLabel/resolveRowLabel); no renderer keeps its own copy. An empty string is a deliberate 'no label' (a heading / legend / prose body is never prefixed with its role word). Adding or changing an entry is a VOCABULARY CHANGE (axioms §0): log it in failures.md first, never ad hoc while encoding.
